name: Fleetbar
author: StratoForce AI
description: Your fleet's heartbeat in the bar: Tailscale node status plus any Prometheus/VictoriaMetrics checks with thresholds — failures surface explicitly, never as silent green.

barWidget.description: Click: fleet panel. Middle click: force refresh. Right click: open your dashboard.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often the collector polls Tailscale and your metrics source. Opening the panel and middle-clicking both force a refresh.

schema.label: Show node count next to the icon
schema.description: Horizontal bars only; the icon alone still carries severity color, and issues always append a !N marker.

schema.label: Notify on severity changes
schema.description: Desktop notification when the fleet's overall severity changes — what broke, or that it recovered. Flap-guarded to at most one ping per five minutes; a shell restart never re-announces an ongoing incident.
